frozen_selection_rule_if_and_only_if_ide: Enumerate the complete pinned index without label values, class counts or model outcomes.
Exclude every SWIFT, SYNERGY V5, KIFMS V7 and V9/V10 review identity and every frozen prior content identity.
Require title, abstract, provider-native keywords and binary label schema plus exact CC-BY-4.0 or CC0 rights.
Require nonempty provider-native keywords in the frozen predeclared completeness fraction; never impute keywords from title or abstract.
Select the seven smallest eligible label-blind raw row counts, breaking ties by review identity; retain all seven.
Freeze exact source bytes, canonical population, content disjointness, keyword coverage, u4 and keyword-only representation before labels or outcomes.

historical_corroboration_target.purpose: Establish provenance of the V13-frozen expected bytes only; this route is not authorized as a substitute.

matched_performance_contract_unchanged.costs: All parsing, vectorization, fitting and ranking costs charged
matched_performance_contract_unchanged.fallback: Exact u4 on any binding or signal failure

no_substitution_rule: If the frozen commit/path bytes do not equal the frozen expected index SHA-256, stop before index parsing, review census, review CSV download, labels, models, rankings and metrics. The historical owner is provenance evidence only and cannot replace the frozen route in V14.

post_discovery_boundary.purpose: Content-addressed reproduction and causal lineage diagnosis of the already observed source-identity failure.

prohibitions: No V12 or V13 edit, retry or relabelling.
No index JSON parsing after the byte-identity mismatch.
No review census or review CSV download.
No label value or class-count inspection or retention.
No learner, model, ranking, metric, scorer, protected-outcome or prohibited C4 execution.
No claim that the seven-review family exists or that keywords improve screening.
No independent, protected, submission-ready or top-tier claim.
No manuscript, shared ledger, Git or other-lane edit.
scientific_question: Does the exact V13-frozen repository commit and path resolve byte-for-byte to the separately frozen V13 index identity, and if not, which exact commit-tree-blob lineage owns each identity?

pass_rule_for_route_acquisition: The frozen commit resolves to one exact root tree.
That root tree binds index_v1.json to the frozen expected Git blob SHA-1 and byte count.
The raw path bytes reproduce both the tree-bound Git blob SHA-1 and frozen expected SHA-256.
All three custody roles are independently bound before any subsequent census.
reproducibility_diagnosis_rule: Fetch commit metadata, its exact root tree and raw index bytes for the frozen route without parsing the index bytes.
Compute raw byte count, SHA-256 and Git blob SHA-1 in memory; never retain the index body.
Fetch the historical target commit, root tree and raw index bytes only to locate the frozen expected identity; never substitute it.
If frozen route acquisition fails, emit the exact causal mismatch and stop before census.

stop_boundary: The first failed identity conjunct terminates V14 before source census and performance.
